answer: Concretely, the economy can chain each registration to a per-identity nonce derived from the prior epoch hash so clones collide. Link analysis on reused seeds marks the whole set. Because it works by raising the marginal cost per fabricated identity to roughly a full epoch of compute, suspected siblings are frozen pending external review. The network ties the pulse to sunk effort, uses the mesa as an corroborating signal, then requires a copper before any payout.
